trial.program_source:
def transform(grid):
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    counts=[sum(v!=0 for v in r) for r in grid]
    r=max(range(h),key=lambda i:counts[i])
    cells=[j for j,v in enumerate(grid[r]) if v]
    if not cells:return out
    color=grid[r][cells[0]]
    up=[j for j in range(w) if r>0 and grid[r-1][j]==color]
    down=[j for j in range(w) if r+1<h and grid[r+1][j]==color]
    if not up or not down:return out
    a,b=up[0],down[0]; d=abs(a-b)
    if not d:return out
    lu=0
    while r-lu-1>=0 and grid[r-lu-1][a]==color:lu+=1
    ld=0
    while r+ld+1<h and grid[r+ld+1][b]==color:ld+=1
    target=r+h//2 if r<h//2 else r-h//2
    for j in range(w):
        out[target][j]=color
        if j%(2*d)==(d if a<b else 0):
            for k in range(1,lu+1):
                if target-k>=0:out[target-k][j]=color
        if j%(2*d)==(0 if a<b else d):
            for k in range(1,ld+1):
                if target+k<h:out[target+k][j]=color
    return out
